content: Poropeta Apakukumi Kamongo Anatu baa keta epo nolakayamo kandeya dokona lao pii palamo.
Apakukumi Mumu Leya
O Kamongo, Namwa randa andake nao karamano dokona yuu akipare nyisa lao kee laro dokopa sepala namwa nyisarese?

Akipamo namba randa dupwanako lenge lenge rao kara, letese? Embame dee apa pyuo koo dupwa pyuo karena lapala mee kando karese? Pyao kokwa singi yulupi randa dupwape namba karapu dokona minyuo buale minyuo laiya lao pyakando pyuo epelyaminyi.
Mawa pii dupwa angi ingya napala kote pii dupwa rolae laa nalyaminyi. Kote rolae doko nyuo kapu kyepala akali koo pingi dupwame yulu rolae doko nyuo anamasi minyilyaminyi.
Kamongome Pii Yano Piya

Kamongome banya wambu dupwa lamaiyuo dopa leya. Nakamame wambu rara wakale nakamana parali maki ingyuo palaminyi dupwa kandalapape. Nakama kararami gii dusipana yulu mende piru doko mendeme langyuo rolara ramo doko nakama kinyilyamo lao suu pyaa narami ingilya kande.
Bapilone wambu poraiyuo kaepala kui lao kara nange dupwa lanyuo epelyo. Epelyo dupwa yanda lakao epapala wambu dupwa pyao anamasi minyalominyi.
Nakamame Anatunya mawa pii kamba lao karenge dokopa wambu dupwame kando pakame kumuo karaminyi.

Dokopa nakamana mena ose dupwame mena lepete dupwa nyuo enakao makandenge. Makandapala lopapala nalana pingi dopale ingya napala kamame nalana wakasa pingi. Dopa pilyamopa nakama nanesa dupwame mena ose matana piso waiya lao pyala epenge. Yaka kambeme kinjipa pongo pyapala nyingi dopale ingyuo nyela epelyaminyi.

Nakamana yanda singi dupwame wambu dupwa pyao kumakala epelyaminyi. Epelyaminyi dokopa wambu dupwame kando pakame kumulyaminyi. Wambu puu maiyuo lanyuo eparami dupwa ipwa kee ingyarasa kando yaka lalana saka narami.

Nakamame kiŋi akali dupwape kamongo yulu andake pingi dupwape kilya kando giyalya giyana pyuo lenge. Wambu epa nana lao kana kame londe pingi dupwana panya saka naa nange. Nakamame mee yuu kyaso reto ketae nyepala yalala sukusa papala yuu andape mee nyingi.
Rangena porainya renge anatuŋu lao lakandenge akali dupwame porambaiye dopale ingyuo waiya lao epo penge.
Apakukumi Anatu Kando Dee Kamba Mumu Leya

Kamongo emba ene lokoyamopa baa Anatuko karee. Emba nambana Anatu poo pyasi lete karalu karenge. Kamongo nambana Anatu namba kyawa minyuo karenge dokome Bapilone wambu dupwa namwa randa jinya lapala porainyi pyambuo rombo palyuo pii.

Embame akali koo panga singi dupwa akipamo mee pyuo karena lapala kando karese? Embena lenge ama poo pyasi keyange dokome koo dupwa kandare ingya nange. Wambu yulu koo pingi dupwa embame epe kanda nange. Dokona akipamo yulu koo pingi wambu dupwame wambu yulu rolae pingi dupwa kokwa sinya lapala romo napyuo karese?
Aki rengendena wambu dupwa kau oma ingyuo galu aimbupi ingyuo nakamana lita kara nange ingyuo pyao nembapala kaelese?
Bapilone wambu dupwame wambu dupwa kau oma sinyana malyuo nyingi doko suu pyao oma ingyuo waiko nyingi. Nyuo nyuuna palyapala ipyuo pao dokopa dopa pyuo nyimwa lao rae maiyuo wamya lyingi.
Dopa pipala nakamame nakamana oma nyingi sinyana dupwame oma keyange dupwako nyuo jingi lapala bange rendamu pingi dupwa kiso maiyuo lakandenge.
Dopa pyuo karo dokopa nakamame wua gela dupwame yuu peparae minyaro karo wambu dupwa konda nao pyao uki palyuo karalu kararamisi?
